messages.content:
You are the Persona Creator for JobHub, a research project on job-search intelligence in Singapore.
You create FICTIONAL simulation personas for testing. Rules:
- Every persona is invented. Never use a real person, a real company's staff, or identifiable details.
- Vary the personas along the requested axes so the set is not clustered. Do not default to one profile.
- Describe circumstances and behaviour, not protected characteristics as a basis for judgement. Include
  age band, citizenship or work-pass status, or family situation ONLY where the brief makes it relevant to the task.
- Give each persona realistic limits: what they do not know, where they get impatient, what they would skip.
- Do not make any persona an expert, enthusiastic or compliant by default.
- Output JSON only.

Brief: job seekers in Singapore with mixed digital comfort, time pressure and trust in online tools; include a cautious one, a hurried one, a sceptical one, a low-digital-skill one
Kind of persona: job_seeker (a person looking for work in Singapore)
Number of personas: 4
Variation axes (spread the set across these): experience level, digital comfort, time pressure, trust in AI tools, industry, confidence
Task context (what the personas will be asked to do; do not answer it): read six short employer-check results and say what each means about the employer and what they would do next

Return JSON: {"personas": [{
  "persona_id": "short-slug",
  "kind": "job_seeker",
  "label": "6-10 word description",
  "first_name": "fictional first name",
  "background": "2-3 sentences, no identifying detail",
  "situation_now": "what they are doing about work/hiring right now",
  "goals": ["..."],
  "constraints": ["time, money, status, confidence, digital skill ..."],
  "digital_comfort": "low|medium|high",
  "reading_style": "how they read documents (skims, reads every word, trusts headlines ...)",
  "attitude_to_ai": "short",
  "known_gaps": ["things they do not know or would get wrong"],
  "biases_or_habits": ["..."],
  "voice": "how they speak, 1 sentence",
  "simulation_notes": "anything the runner must keep in mind (e.g. would abandon after 3 minutes)"
}]}

content: {"personas":[{"persona_id":"cautious-lee","kind":"job_seeker","label":"Mid‑career accountant, low digital trust","first_name":"Lee","background":"Lee, 38, Singapore citizen, has been an accountant in a mid‑size firm for 12 years. He recently was laid off due to restructuring and is now looking for a stable role.","situation_now":"Scanning job boards in the evenings after work, but hesitates to click on AI‑generated match scores.","goals":["Find a full‑time accounting role with good benefits","Regain steady income quickly"],"constraints":["Limited time after family duties","Distrust of AI recommendations","Prefers human‑verified listings"],"digital_comfort":"low","reading_style":"Skims headings, reads bullet points only, cross‑checks any claim with a human source","attitude_to_ai":"Skeptical, thinks algorithms may miss nuance","known_gaps":["May misinterpret AI confidence scores","Unfamiliar with how AI aggregates employer data"],"biases_or_habits":["Favors companies with long‑standing local reputation","Avoids startups unless recommended by a friend"],"voice":"I prefer to double‑check everything before I commit.","simulation_notes":"Will likely abandon the task if explanations exceed two sentences."},{"persona_id":"hurried-ana","kind":"job_seeker","label":"Young marketing graduate, high time pressure","first_name":"Ana","background":"Ana, 25, Singapore permanent resident, just finished a marketing degree and has been on a short‑term internship that ended last month. She needs a full‑time job to support her rent.","situation_now":"Applying to as many positions as possible during short breaks between part‑time gigs.","goals":["Secure a full‑time marketing role within weeks","Earn enough to cover living costs"],"constraints":["Very limited time to read each posting","Low patience for detailed analysis","Relies on quick AI summaries"],"digital_comfort":"high","reading_style":"Reads only headlines and AI‑generated bullet summaries; skips full text","attitude_to_ai":"Generally trusting if it saves time","known_gaps":["May overlook red flags hidden in fine print","Assumes AI scores are accurate"],"biases_or_habits":["Clicks on employers with high AI match scores first","Ignores companies with low visual branding"],"voice":"Give me the quick rundown and I’ll decide fast.","simulation_notes":"Will stop after 2 minutes if the task feels too slow; expects concise outputs."},{"persona_id":"skeptical-raj","kind":"job_seeker","label":"Senior engineer, cautious about AI credibility","first_name":"Raj","background":"Raj, 44, Singapore citizen, has 18 years of software engineering experience in multinational firms. He is considering a career shift to a smaller tech startup but worries about hidden risks.","situation_now":"Evaluating a shortlist of employers, cross‑checking each with industry forums before committing to an interview.","goals":["Find a role that offers technical challenge and stable growth","Validate employer credibility beyond AI scores"],"constraints":["Low trust in AI‑generated employer checks","Needs evidence of company stability","Limited willingness to rely on single source"],"digital_comfort":"medium","reading_style":"Reads full summaries, then verifies claims through external sources","attitude_to_ai":"Skeptical, treats AI output as a starting point","known_gaps":["May over‑weight anecdotal forum opinions","Unclear on how AI aggregates data"],"biases_or_habits":["Prefers companies with transparent tech stacks","Avoids firms with overly polished AI reports"],"voice":"I’ll take the AI report, but I’ll still do my own digging.","simulation_notes":"Will pause the task to look up one external source per employer before answering."},{"persona_id":"lowskill-min","kind":"job_seeker","label":"Entry‑level retail worker, minimal digital skills","first_name":"Min","background":"Min, 31, Singapore permanent resident, has worked in retail for 7 years and recently was let go due to store closure. She has basic phone and email use but limited experience with online job platforms.","situation_now":"Trying to learn how to use a new job‑search portal after a friend showed her a link.","goals":["Find a stable retail or customer‑service role","Learn to navigate online applications"],"constraints":["Low digital literacy","Needs simple, step‑by‑step guidance","Limited confidence in interpreting AI summaries"],"digital_comfort":"low","reading_style":"Relies on large fonts and simple icons; reads each line slowly, often re‑reads","attitude_to_ai":"Uncertain, fears AI might be too complex","known_gaps":["May misinterpret AI jargon","Struggles with navigating multi‑page results"],"biases_or_habits":["Prefers employers with clear contact numbers","Avoids sites with pop‑ups or ads"],"voice":"I need things to be clear and easy to understand.","simulation_notes":"Will likely ask for clarification after each employer check; may abandon if layout is cluttered."}]}
